```yaml
name: Flaky Monitor

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  run-flaky-monitor:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Run flaky monitor
        run: cargo run --bin flaky-monitor -- --report-file flaky-report.json

      - name: Upload flaky report as artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: flaky-report
          path: flaky-report.json

  persist-flaky-reports:
    needs: run-flaky-monitor
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - name: Download previous flaky report
        id: download_previous_report
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: flaky-report-previous
          path: flaky-report-previous.json

      - name: Merge current and previous reports
        run: |
          jq --slurp '.[0] * .[1]' flaky-report.json flaky-report-previous.json > merged-flaky-report.json

      - name: Upload merged flaky report as artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: flaky-report-merged
          path: merged-flaky-report.json

  trigger-persist-workflow:
    on:
      workflow_run:
        workflows: [Flaky Monitor]
        types: [completed]
    jobs:
      trigger:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        steps:
          - name: Trigger persist-flaky-reports workflow
            run: echo "Triggering persist-flaky-reports workflow"
            env:
              GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
